notes.title: Fireside Pre Alpha Patch
notes.content:
Greeting Travelers,

There was one core takeaway from the feedback and data we got from the playtest on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722700/Fireside/]Steam[/url] back in January: Fireside has a great atmosphere and okay gameplay. This means the way we can improve our game is by improving the gameplay. Therefore, we’re back with our very first playtest patch extending some of the current gameplay systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115501/6796ba890d45095f223159087777683ce59b0148.gif[/img]

However, we need to be careful when doing this, since Fireside’s core vision is a cozy game about the breaks on a journey. The calmness of the campfire is an essential part of this vision, and this means keeping a focus on dialogue and not flooding the player with micro-management decisions.

Therefore, we’re trying the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to upgrade shrines.
[list]
[*] Each shrine starts out at level one and can be upgraded two times with soul energy tokens and different materials depending on where the shrine is located.
[list]
[*] Level 1: Send home up to two item stacks from this shrine
[*] Level 2: This shrine can now be used as a starting point for your journey
[*] Level 3: Send home up to three item stacks from this shrine
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Two new campsite environments in the forest area.
[*] Desire Hints
[list]
[*] NPCs now tell you about items desired at nearby campfires
[/list]
[*] Speech bubble variants
[list]
[*] Speech bubbles now show whether an NPC wants to tell you about
[list]
[*] an item that is desired at a nearby campfire
[*] a traveler is waiting for you at a nearby campfire
[/list]
[/list]
[*]  Three new campfire stories based on the stories you submitted
[*]  Balancing and bugfixes
[list]
[*]  It is easier to gain soul energy tokens but requires more soul energy tokens to upgrade.
[/list]
[/list]

Once again, we’d like to have your feedback on how these changes have influenced gameplay. Remember that these features are a work in progress and we’re looking forward to trying more things. If you’ve got any suggestions gladly [url=https://discord.gg/QRhHR6X]join our Discord server[/url]!

[url=https://discord.gg/QRhHR6X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115501/0206a3bece0c3bf3877076a30f3c5c7766f09466.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patchnotes Fireside v. 0.1
notes.content:
After gathering all the feedback & bug reports from the Fireside playtest we went to work to fix the currently testable version of the game!

So without further ado here are the very first Fireside patch notes:

[b]Features[/b]

- Deployed Mac Build
- Added fallback portrait for procedural NPC portraits

[b]Changes[/b]

- Turned developer commentary off by default
- Adapted intensity of day / night animation
- Removes [...] speech bubbles when NPCs communicated desires

[b]Bug Fixes
[/b]
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to abort a trade after confirming it
- Removed invisible ascii characters (boxes) in Hazel dialogue
- Fixed overlapping text in castle happening
- Fixed a bunch of typos
- Fixed a bug where items could be lost on the journey over screen
- Fixed a bug where Soul Energy tokens weren’t saved
- Fixed game crash when going to the island
- Fixed tooltips not showing when opening inventory the first time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115501/495127a408c81554c0b6f5949ed9b4e57f2377e0.png[/img]
